steps.tutorSL: Živjo! Jaz sem Ana. Ko prideš v kavarno, pozdraviš: »Dober dan.« Zdaj ti.
steps.tutorEN: Hi! I'm Ana. When you walk into a café, you greet: "Dober dan." (Good day.) Your turn.

steps.tutorSL: Lepo! Ena pomembna beseda: »prosim«. Reci jo.
steps.tutorEN: Nice! One important word: "prosim" (please). Say it.

steps.tutorSL: In »hvala« — to je thank you. Reci: »Hvala.«
Zdaj nekaj uporabnega. Naroči kavo: »Eno kavo, prosim.«
steps.tutorEN: Now something useful. Order a coffee: "Eno kavo, prosim." (One coffee, please.)

steps.tutorSL: Če me ne razumeš, reci: »Ne razumem.«
steps.tutorEN: If you don't understand me, say: "Ne razumem." (I don't understand.)

steps.tutorSL: Če grem prehitro, reci: »Še enkrat, prosim.«
steps.tutorEN: If I go too fast, say: "Še enkrat, prosim." (Again, please.)

steps.tutorSL: In če ne veš besede, vprašaj mene. Reci: »Kako se reče coffee?«
steps.tutorEN: And if you don't know a word, ask me. Say: "Kako se reče coffee?" (How do you say 'coffee'?)

steps.tutorSL: Super ti gre! Spet greš v kavarno — kako pozdraviš ob vstopu?
steps.tutorEN: You're doing great! You walk into a café again — how do you greet as you enter?

steps.tutorSL: In naroči mi še eno kavo.

steps.tutorEN: Excellent! To finish, say: "Hvala, nasvidenje." (Thanks, goodbye.)
